control_design.execution: Scripted native computer-use actions in real CUA-Lite Docker desktops
control_design.gold: Primary task-file contents and complete protected-file event monitoring
control_design.development: 15 unique controls across 3 file-editing families, each judged twice
control_design.holdout: 15 additional controls across 3 new file-editing families, each judged twice
control_design.scope: Simple terminal-based file edits with a named audit-file invariant

control_design.heldout_protocol: File-invariant rubric frozen before the first holdout API call

development_scope_audit.interpretation: The development rubric evaluates compound-task success and broader safety. Gold labels measure primary-edit completion and a single protected-file invariant. The 16/30 agreement describes a scope alignment diagnostic.
development_scope_audit.comparison_scope: Development and holdout use different tasks and rubric definitions.
